enumeration_method: flowsforapex.org sitemap.xml (367 URLs: 88 under latest/, 254 under archived version prefixes v5.1.2..v25.1, 25 top-level incl. posts/* and Flows4APEX*Features); GitHub tree API git/trees/development?recursive=1 -> 174 .bpmn paths; flowquest.net sitemap (38); blog.flowquest.net sitemap (13). latest/ resolved to v26.1 (nav 'V26.1 New Features', meta 'Flows for APEX v26.1 Installation Guide').
browser_tool: chrome-devtools-mcp (mcp__cdp1__*) for live pages; curl for the static sites and raw.githubusercontent.com
note: Population definition per orchestrator ruling 2026-09-24 (not a keyword filter): frontier = every latest/* page (88) + archived-version pages whose path does NOT exist under latest/ (24 of 254 archived URLs kept; 230 dropped as same-path-as-latest) + flowsforapex.org top-level incl. posts/* and Flows4APEX*Features (25) + every .bpmn on the repo default branch 'development' (174) + flowquest.net (38) + blog.flowquest.net (13) = 362, vs the assignment's estimate of 15. The LinkedIn release post is out of scope per Gate 1 ruling B4 (vendor sources only), not BLOCKED. /dev/ docs are not a surface: the two real links to it from flowquest.net/releases 404 and sitemap.xml has no /dev/ entry. Chrome artifacts: the docs sidebar injects 'AI Service Tasks' links into every docs page and flowquest post pages carry a related-posts widget with AI-titled teasers; nav/aside/footer plus class-matched sidebar/related widgets were stripped before AI-token scoring, and residual widget text is visible in the affected rows' evidence. Mechanical classification for the 329 non-judgement rows: no artefact image -> E0; artefact images but no AI token in the page's own text -> E2; repo .bpmn with no AI extension element -> E2 (evidence = the file's own process id). The three images that ARE BPMN-with-AI artefacts in this source (ai-service-task-tax-example-diagram.png, ahsp-261-autonomous-def.png, 261-autonomous-ahsp-definition.png) are mapped to records 001-003, and ANY other page carrying one of them is E3 duplicate_of that record even if it also carries other images (9 rows: n=121,122,131,322,325,327,335,342,344). 23 judgement exclusions (6.35% of the population) are listed in the final report; 19 carry needs_visual_check=true and are the researcher's visual re-check list. Five archives were missing after the first fetch and were re-fetched (flowsforapex.org root, flowquest.net root, /blog/, /adhoc-subprocesses-basics/, blog.flowquest.net root); 0 BLOCKED rows. Surface D rows carry the percent-encoded (fetchable) form of the repo path while the frontier file lists it un-encoded; same resources. Rows were written in one generator pass after all items were judged; n = the item's line index in the frontier file (comment lines excluded).
